title: Public signals → testable product questions
scope: Independent portfolio research. Public priorities and individual feedback inspire hypotheses; they do not establish internal StepStone incidents or prove a model improves conversion.

opportunities.title: Make every result reviewable
opportunities.signal: The current Product Analyst role combines tracking validation, experiments, opportunity sizing and AI-assisted analysis with responsibility for correctness.
opportunities.hypothesis: A visible denominator, source and readiness check can help analysts catch unsupported conclusions before a leadership review.
opportunities.measure: Mapped rows, available exposure counts, experiment provenance and numeric evidence lineage.

opportunities.title: Investigate role relevance before rollout
opportunities.signal: StepStone's 2025 candidate-journey research describes hybrid AI and traditional search behavior, alongside concerns about answer quality and trust.
opportunities.hypothesis: AI ranking may help some job roles more than others. Compare valid role-level outcomes and inspect device, market and acquisition mix.
opportunities.measure: Exposure → application conversion, completion, latency and cost; role slices remain exploratory.

opportunities.title: Evaluate the analyst's AI, too
opportunities.signal: An indexed public LinkedIn recommendation by a former manager describes a StepStone analyst's work on LLM evaluation and an analytics agent architecture.
opportunities.hypothesis: Compare model outputs on valid catalog IDs, schema mapping and evidence coverage rather than treating fluent explanations as accuracy.
opportunities.measure: Validated result IDs, parsing coverage, actual provider latency, missing billing data and evidence-only fallback.

opportunities.title: Separate discovery from application friction
opportunities.signal: German Reddit discussions contain mixed experiences: successful job searches alongside concerns about irrelevant suggestions and missing employer feedback.
opportunities.hypothesis: A ranking improvement may fail to improve completed applications if upload friction, job relevance or external handoffs dominate.
opportunities.measure: Role and device funnels, application errors, listing freshness and feedback events when those columns are supplied.

opportunities.title: Keep model recommendations explainable
opportunities.signal: StepStone publicly identifies explainability, autonomy and responsible handling of user data as technology principles.
opportunities.hypothesis: Source-linked explanations and private workspace uploads make model-assisted investigation easier to inspect and control.
opportunities.measure: Source attribution, workspace isolation and model output validation; behavioral slices do not establish demographic fairness.
opportunities.source: The Stepstone Group · Responsible product and technology
